basis: Example user-declared progressive/deep-house/ambient-techno baseline, not measured Spotify listening history. Customize from private preferences and actual history.

tiers.name: Closest to current listening
tiers.connection: Progressive house, deep/melodic house, ambient techno and Anjunadeep-like atmosphere
tiers.difference: New releases, mixes, artists and labels within familiar rhythmic and emotional territory

tiers.name: Adjacent exploration
tiers.connection: Atmosphere, emotional development and texture remain; rhythm or production language shifts
tiers.difference: Ambient/electronic hybrids, IDM, leftfield downtempo, organic grooves and processed guitar

tiers.name: Furthest away, with a clear connection
tiers.connection: Spaciousness, gradual transformation, expressive intensity, unusual timbre or a compositional journey
tiers.difference: Spiritual/modal/free jazz, post-rock, minimal/contemporary classical, electroacoustic and regional traditions
